institution.name: University of Arkansas Community College at Batesville

plan.notes: Source: UACCB 2026-2027 College Catalog, General Education and Transfer Programs PDF (sequence) and Degrees and Certificates overview PDF (program requirements). Suggested Course Sequence published term-by-term (13+16+16+15 = 60). Program requirements list PHIL 11003 and PSYC 11003 as required core courses; the sequence embeds them in generic 'Humanities Requirement 1' and 'Social Sciences Requirement 1' slots (documented mapping). Directed Elective footnote: 'Eligible for the Certificate of General Studies if completing Digital Literacy, Computer Software Applications, or Introduction to Computers as a Program Elective Requirement in term 1' -- first-listed Digital Literacy (BUSI 10663) used. Choice slots use first-listed from each official list; subsequent same-type slots use the next distinct course to avoid duplication (documented). Three 'Elective' slots (2nd Spring/Fall) draw from the 21-credit Program Electives pool; catalog does not specify courses, so generic ELECTIVE placeholders are used (not invented).
